purpose: Update the property-title legal audit to reflect the Irish Statute Book revised Registration of Title Act record updated to 18 June 2026.

current_revised_baseline.current_effects_include: Act No. 11 of 2026 and S.I. No. 269 of 2026

new_audit_observation: The earlier verification package must not be treated as the final amendment inventory because the revised Act record contains effects through June 2026.

provisions.note: The current statutory rule states the conclusiveness of the register while preserving court jurisdiction based on actual fraud or mistake.
The enacted provision establishes absolute, qualified and possessory freehold title classes; current revised effects require final cross-check.
Registered-land acquisition by possession is expressly linked to the Statute of Limitations and an application to the Registrar.
Section 85 states that, except as provided by the Act, the register/map description is not conclusive as to boundaries or extent.

additional_verified_effect.finding: The 2009 Act substituted s.25 concerning compulsory registration and the effect of failure to register where registration is compulsory.

critical_update.finding: The 2021 Act repealed ss.33-39 of the 2009 Act and preserved pending proceedings/applications, while amending s.49A of the 1964 Act. This does not by itself repeal the s.49 registered-land possession framework.

audit_action: Reconcile every user-facing property-title proposition against the June 2026 revised Act record before publication.
guardrails: Revised-law baseline does not replace provision-level amendment/commencement analysis.
The 2026 revised record must be treated as the current baseline for the final audit.
